CustomField.description: Adjusted exchange rate used for reporting on renewal opportunities (current year renewals only).
CustomField.formula: IF( Previous_Currency__c = 'USD' || Previous_Currency__c = 'EUR', Previous_Subs_Deal_Value__c / Previous_Opportunity_Exchange_Rate__c, IF( Previous_Currency__c = 'GBP', Previous_Subs_Deal_Value__c / Exchange_Rate__c, Previous_Subs_Deal_Value__c ) )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Adjusted exchange rate used for reporting on renewal opportunities (current year renewals only).
